name: Honeybadger MCP
description: Lets coding agents query Honeybadger errors, Insights data, dashboards, alarms and check-ins through a hosted OAuth MCP server or a self-hosted container.

skills.name: Fault Triage
skills.description: Lists and filters faults, reads their notices and affected users, and updates resolved, ignored, or assignee state.

skills.name: Insights Queries
skills.description: Runs BadgerQL queries against Honeybadger Insights data and lists the data streams available for a project.

skills.name: Dashboards and Alarms
skills.description: Creates, updates and inspects Insights dashboards and alarms, including alarm trigger history, when writes are enabled.

skills.name: Check-In Monitoring
skills.description: Lists, creates and updates check-ins that monitor cron jobs and scheduled tasks for a Honeybadger project.

skills.name: Project Reports
skills.description: Gets project details, occurrence counts, integrations, and report data for your Honeybadger projects.
